literal: All overdue debts from before the nineteenth year were completely remitted.
idiomatic: All overdue debts dating from before the nineteenth year were completely remitted.

literal: Where harvest failed last year, reductions were to be assessed and reported.
idiomatic: Where the harvest had failed the previous year, reductions were to be assessed and reported.

literal: In especially distressed places, envoys were sent to the commanderies and counties for relief as circumstances required.
idiomatic: In the most distressed districts, envoys were dispatched to the commanderies and counties to provide relief as local conditions required.

literal: All who wished to attach themselves to farming but lacked seed grain were additionally given loans.
idiomatic: All who wished to return to farming but lacked seed grain were additionally granted loans.

literal: Those engaged in establishing the thousand-mu fields and the corvée workers of the various supervising offices were granted cloth, each according to rank.
idiomatic: Corvée workers in the offices overseeing the thousand-mu fields were granted cloth, each according to rank.

literal: On the wuwu day, Yiqing, Prince of Linchuan and General of the Guard, died.
idiomatic: On the wuwu day, Prince of Linchuan Yiqing, General of the Guard, died.

literal: On the xinyou day, Liu Yizong, Supervisor of the Heir Apparent's Household, was made Governor of Southern Xu Province.
idiomatic: On the xinyou day, Liu Yizong, Supervisor of the Heir Apparent's Household, was appointed Governor of Southern Xu Province.

literal: On the gengwu day of the second month, Zhao Bofu, General Who Leads the Army, was made Governor of Yu Province.
idiomatic: On the gengwu day of the second month, Zhao Bofu, General Who Leads the Army, was appointed Governor of Yu Province.

literal: On the jichou day, Yigong, Prince of Jiangxia, Minister over the Masses and Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing, was advanced to Grand Commandant and continued as Minister over the Masses.
idiomatic: On the jichou day, Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, Minister over the Masses and Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing, was promoted to Grand Commandant while retaining the post of Minister over the Masses.

literal: On the gengyin day, Shen Yanzhi, General of the Right Guards, was made Director of the Central Army.
idiomatic: On the gengyin day, Shen Yanzhi, General of the Right Guards, was appointed Director of the Central Army.

literal: On the xinmao day, the seventh imperial son Hong was established as Prince of Jianping.
idiomatic: On the xinmao day, the seventh imperial son Hong was created Prince of Jianping.

literal: On the jiawu day, Dan, Prince of Guangling, was made Governor of Southern Xu Province.
idiomatic: On the jiawu day, Prince of Guangling Dan was appointed Governor of Southern Xu Province.

literal: In the fourth month of summer, Xu Geng of Yanling in Jinling contributed a thousand hu of grain to aid famine relief.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, Xu Geng of Yanling in Jinling contributed a thousand hu of grain to relieve the famine-stricken.

literal: On the renxu day of the fifth month, He Shangzhi, Director of the Masters of Writing, was made General of the Central Army; Liu Daoxi, Consulting Colonel, was made Governor of Guang Province.
idiomatic: On the renxu day of the fifth month, He Shangzhi, Director of the Masters of Writing, was appointed General of the Central Army; Liu Daoxi, Consulting Colonel, was appointed Governor of Guang Province.

literal: In the sixth month, rain fell continuously.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, rain fell without cease.

literal: On the dinghai day, an edict said: "Rain has fallen day after day; flooding has become a disaster, and the people, having grown spare in their stores, easily fall into want.
idiomatic: On the dinghai day, an edict said: "Rain has fallen day after day; flooding has become a disaster, and the people, their stores grown spare, easily fall into want.

literal: The chief officials of the two counties and the departmental offices of the garrisons shall each, according to their jurisdiction, inspect and verify and supply firewood and grain, ensuring that provision is complete."
idiomatic: The chief officials of the two counties and the departmental offices of the garrisons shall each, within their jurisdiction, inspect and verify accounts and supply firewood and grain, ensuring that nothing is left wanting."

literal: On the dingyou day of the seventh month in autumn, Jun, Prince of Shixing and Governor of Yang Province, was additionally made General of the Central Army; Jun, Prince of Wuling and Governor of Southern Yu Province, was additionally made General Who Pacifies the Army.
idiomatic: On the dingyou day of the seventh month in autumn, Prince of Shixing Jun, Governor of Yang Province, was additionally appointed General of the Central Army; Prince of Wuling Jun, Governor of Southern Yu Province, was additionally appointed General Who Pacifies the Army.

literal: [30] On the yisi day, an edict said: "In recent years grain crops have been injured and excessive rain has become a calamity—this is also because the proper seasons for planting have not yet been fully observed.
idiomatic: [30] On the yisi day, an edict said: "In recent years the grain harvest has suffered injury and excessive rain has brought calamity—this is also because the proper seasons for planting have not yet been fully observed.

literal: In the commanderies subordinate to Southern Xu, Yan, Yu, and the western districts of Yang Province beyond the Zhe River, from now on all are to be directed to plant wheat to help supply what is lacking.
idiomatic: In Southern Xu, Yan, Yu, and the western districts of Yang Province beyond the Zhe River, all are henceforth to be directed to plant wheat to help make up what is lacking.

literal: Seed now available in Pengcheng and Xiapi commanderies is to be transported quickly and entrusted to the inspectors for loan and distribution.
idiomatic: Seed now available in Pengcheng and Xiapi commanderies is to be transported at once and entrusted to the inspectors for loan and distribution.

literal: The soil of Xu and Yu has many paddy fields, yet among the people dry cultivation alone is pursued; orders may be sent to the two garrisons to put old embankments back in use, jointly repair and establish them, and also assign reclamation so that this is achieved by next year.
idiomatic: The soil of Xu and Yu has many paddy fields, yet the people devote themselves solely to dry cultivation; orders should be sent to the two garrisons to put the old embankments back in service, jointly repair and establish them, and also assign reclamation so that the work is completed by next year.

literal: In all commanderies and provinces, each is ordered to exhaust the land's advantage, encourage and guide planting and cultivation, and in sericulture, mulberry, hemp, and ramie each give full effort to its method—they must not merely carry out documents on paper."
idiomatic: In every province and commandery, all are ordered to exhaust the land's advantage, encourage planting and cultivation, and give full effort to sericulture, mulberry, hemp, and ramie each in its season—they must not merely carry out documents on paper."

literal: On the wuchen day of the eighth month, Yiji, Prince of Hengyang, Grand General Who Campaigns West and Governor of Jing Province, was made Grand General Who Campaigns North, Commissioner with Credentials Equal to the Three Dukes, and Governor of Southern Xu Province; Yixuan, Prince of Nanqiao, General Who Campaigns North and Governor of Southern Xu Province, was made General of Chariots and Cavalry and Governor of Jing Province.
idiomatic: On the wuchen day of the eighth month, Prince of Hengyang Yiji, Grand General Who Campaigns West and Governor of Jing Province, was appointed Grand General Who Campaigns North, Commissioner with Credentials Equal to the Three Dukes, and Governor of Southern Xu Province; Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan, General Who Campaigns North and Governor of Southern Xu Province, was appointed General of Chariots and Cavalry and Governor of Jing Province.

literal: [31] Dan, Prince of Guangling and Governor of Southern Yan Province, was made Governor of Southern Xu Province.
idiomatic: [31] Prince of Guangling Dan, Governor of Southern Yan Province, was appointed Governor of Southern Xu Province.

literal: On the jiachen day of the ninth month, Juqu Anzhou was made Grand General Who Campaigns West and Governor of Liang Province and was enfeoffed as Prince of Hexi.
idiomatic: On the jiachen day of the ninth month, Juqu Anzhou was appointed Grand General Who Campaigns West and Governor of Liang Province and was enfeoffed as Prince of Hexi.

literal: On the jimao day of the tenth month in winter, Xu Qiong, General of the Left Army, was made Governor of Yan Province; Shen Tian, Senior Clerk of the Grand General, was made Governor of Ji Province.
idiomatic: On the jimao day of the tenth month in winter, Xu Qiong, General of the Left Army, was appointed Governor of Yan Province; Shen Tian, Senior Clerk of the Grand General, was appointed Governor of Ji Province.

literal: On the xinmao day, the first of the first month in spring of the twenty-second year, the Yuanjia new calendar of He Chengtian, Imperial Censor, was adopted.
idiomatic: On the xinmao day, the first of the first month in spring of the twenty-second year, the Yuanjia new calendar compiled by Imperial Censor He Chengtian was adopted.

literal: On the renchen day, Jun, Prince of Wuling, General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Southern Yu Province, was changed to Governor of Yong Province; Shuo, Prince of Nanping and Governor of Xiang Province, was made Governor of Southern Yu Province.
idiomatic: On the renchen day, Prince of Wuling Jun, General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Southern Yu Province, was reassigned as Governor of Yong Province; Prince of Nanping Shuo, Governor of Xiang Province, was appointed Governor of Southern Yu Province.

literal: On the xinsi day of the second month, Wang Senglang, Attendant-in-Ordinary, was made Governor of Xiang Province.
idiomatic: On the xinsi day of the second month, Wang Senglang, Attendant-in-Ordinary, was appointed Governor of Xiang Province.

literal: On the jiaxu day, the eighth imperial son Hui was established as Prince of Donghai, and the ninth imperial son Chang as Prince of Yiyang.
idiomatic: On the jiaxu day, the eighth imperial son Hui was created Prince of Donghai, and the ninth imperial son Chang was created Prince of Yiyang.

literal: On the xinhai day of the sixth month in summer, Shuo, Prince of Nanping and Governor of Southern Yu Province, was made Governor of Yu Province.
idiomatic: On the xinhai day of the sixth month in summer, Prince of Nanping Shuo, Governor of Southern Yu Province, was appointed Governor of Yu Province.

literal: On the jiwei day of the seventh month in autumn, Meng Kai, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; He Shangzhi, General of the Central Army, was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
idiomatic: On the jiwei day of the seventh month in autumn, Meng Kai, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, was appointed Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; He Shangzhi, General of the Central Army, was appointed Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

literal: Jun, Prince of Wuling and Governor of Yong Province, campaigned against the Man along the Han River and moved more than fourteen thousand households to the capital.
idiomatic: Prince of Wuling Jun, Governor of Yong Province, campaigned against the Man along the Han River and relocated more than fourteen thousand households to the capital.

literal: On the yiyou day, Yiji, Prince of Hengyang, Grand General Who Campaigns North and Governor of Southern Xu Province, was changed to Governor of Xu Province.
idiomatic: On the yiyou day, Prince of Hengyang Yiji, Grand General Who Campaigns North and Governor of Southern Xu Province, was reassigned as Governor of Xu Province.

literal: On the jiwei day of the ninth month, [32] the prohibition on wine was lifted.
idiomatic: On the jiwei day of the ninth month, [32] the prohibition on wine was lifted.

literal: In the tenth month of winter, a thousand qing of abandoned fields at Hushu were brought back into cultivation.
idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, a thousand qing of abandoned fields at Hushu were brought back into cultivation.

literal: On the yiwei day of the twelfth month, Fan Ye, Supervisor of the Heir Apparent's Household, plotted rebellion; he and his associates were all executed.
idiomatic: On the yiwei day of the twelfth month, Fan Ye, Supervisor of the Heir Apparent's Household, plotted rebellion; he and his associates were all executed.

literal: On the dingyou day, Yikang, Prince of Pengcheng and Grand General, was stripped of rank and reduced to commoner status.
idiomatic: On the dingyou day, Grand General Prince of Pengcheng Yikang was stripped of rank and reduced to commoner status.

literal: On the gengxu day, Zhao Bofu, former Governor of Yu Province, was made General Who Protects the Army.
idiomatic: On the gengxu day, Zhao Bofu, former Governor of Yu Province, was appointed General Who Protects the Army.

literal: On the dingsi day of the first month in spring of the twenty-third year, Lu Hui, Administrator of Changsha, was made Governor of Yi Province.
idiomatic: On the dingsi day of the first month in spring of the twenty-third year, Lu Hui, Administrator of Changsha, was appointed Governor of Yi Province.

literal: On the gengshen day, Meng Kai, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, left office.
idiomatic: On the gengshen day, Meng Kai, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, resigned his post.

literal: Displaced persons from Han-chuan were moved to the banks of the Mian.
idiomatic: Displaced persons from Han-chuan were resettled along the Mian.

literal: Editorial footnote marker 33 in the source text.
idiomatic: Editorial footnote marker 33 in the source text.

literal: On the guimao day of the second month, Liu Yibin, General of the Left Guards, was made Governor of Southern Xu Province.
idiomatic: On the guimao day of the second month, Liu Yibin, General of the Left Guards, was appointed Governor of Southern Xu Province.

literal: In the third month, the Suolu raided Yan and Yu; Shen Tian, Inspector of Qing and Ji provinces, defeated them.
idiomatic: In the third month, the Suolu raided Yan and Yu; Shen Tian, Inspector of Qing and Ji provinces, defeated them.

literal: On the dingwei day of the fourth month in summer, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
idiomatic: On the dingwei day of the fourth month in summer, a general amnesty was proclaimed.

literal: On the guiwei day, the first of the sixth month, there was a solar eclipse.
idiomatic: On the guiwei day, the first of the sixth month, there was a solar eclipse.

literal: Tan Hezhi, Governor of Jiao Province, attacked the state of Lin-yi and conquered it.
idiomatic: Tan Hezhi, Governor of Jiao Province, attacked Lin-yi and conquered it.

literal: On the xinwei day of the seventh month in autumn, Du Tan, Regular Attendant-in-Ordinary, was made Governor of Qing Province.
idiomatic: On the xinwei day of the seventh month in autumn, Du Tan, Regular Attendant-in-Ordinary, was appointed Governor of Qing Province.

literal: On the guimao day of the eighth month, bandits of Jieyang in red paint attacked Jian'an Commandery and burned the prefectural and commandery offices.
idiomatic: On the guimao day of the eighth month, the red-painted bandits of Jieyang attacked Jian'an Commandery and burned the prefectural and commandery offices.

literal: On the jimao day of the ninth month, the imperial carriage visited the Imperial Academy, examined the students by questioning, and fifty-nine answered.
idiomatic: On the jimao day of the ninth month, the Emperor visited the Imperial Academy, examined the students by questioning, and fifty-nine answered.

literal: On the wuzi day of the tenth month in winter, an edict said: "The schools have stood for many years, and the sons of the nobility have completed their studies.
idiomatic: On the wuzi day of the tenth month in winter, an edict said: "The schools have stood for many years, and the sons of the nobility have completed their studies.

literal: Having recently examined them in person, I beheld their flourishing array and, looking far back to Zhu and Si, forever cherish what is past.
idiomatic: Having recently examined them in person, I beheld their flourishing assembly and, looking far back to Zhu and Si, forever cherish what is past.

literal: The students' answers to the questions may largely be adopted for review.
idiomatic: The students' answers in the examination may largely be adopted for review.

literal: The instructors should all receive rewards."
idiomatic: Their instructors should all receive rewards."

literal: Silk was granted, each according to rank.
idiomatic: Silk was distributed, each according to rank.

literal: On the dingyou day of the twelfth month, Xiao Jingxian, Staff Officer of the Dragon-charger, was made Governor of Jiao Province.
idiomatic: On the dingyou day of the twelfth month, Xiao Jingxian, Staff Officer of the Dragon-charger, was appointed Governor of Jiao Province.

literal: That year, the harvest was abundant.
idiomatic: That year brought a great harvest.

literal: The northern embankment was built, Xuanwu Lake was established, and Jingyang Hill was constructed in Hualin Park.
idiomatic: The northern embankment was built, Xuanwu Lake was established, and Jingyang Hill was constructed in Hualin Park.

literal: On the jiaxu day of the first month in spring of the twenty-fourth year, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm, and civil and military officials were granted one rank of promotion.
idiomatic: On the jiaxu day of the first month in spring of the twenty-fourth year, a general amnesty was proclaimed, and civil and military officials were promoted one rank.

literal: Imprisoned convicts received reduced sentences; overdue obligations were leniently reduced, each according to measure.
idiomatic: Imprisoned convicts received reduced sentences; overdue obligations were leniently reduced, each according to measure.

literal: The elderly living alone and those afflicted with the six infirmities who could not support themselves were each granted five hu of grain.
idiomatic: The elderly living alone and those afflicted with the six infirmities who could not support themselves each received five hu of grain.

literal: This year's land tax in Jiankang and Moling counties was remitted by half.
idiomatic: This year's land tax in Jiankang and Moling counties was remitted by half.

literal: On the renshen day of the third month, Zhao Bofu, General Who Protects the Army, was transferred from his post.
idiomatic: On the renshen day of the third month, Zhao Bofu, General Who Protects the Army, was transferred from his post.

literal: On the jiaxu day of the fifth month in summer, Du Tan, Governor of Qing Province, was additionally made Governor of Ji Province.
idiomatic: On the jiaxu day of the fifth month in summer, Du Tan, Governor of Qing Province, was additionally appointed Governor of Ji Province.

literal: In the sixth month, plague struck the capital; on the bingxu day, the commanderies and counties and the departmental offices of the garrisons were all ordered to tour and inspect, supplying medicine.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, plague struck the capital; on the bingxu day, the commanderies and counties and the departmental offices of the garrisons were ordered to conduct inspections throughout and supply medicine.

literal: That month, because goods were costly, large coins were instituted with a value of two.
idiomatic: That month, because goods had grown costly, large coins were instituted with a value of two.

literal: On the yimao day of the seventh month in autumn, the gold, silver, and precious objects taken from Lin-yi were distributed as gifts, each according to rank.
idiomatic: On the yimao day of the seventh month in autumn, the gold, silver, and precious objects taken from Lin-yi were distributed as gifts, each according to rank.

literal: On the yiwei day of the eighth month, Yiji, Prince of Hengyang, Grand General Who Campaigns North and Governor of Xu Province, died.
idiomatic: On the yiwei day of the eighth month, Prince of Hengyang Yiji, Grand General Who Campaigns North and Governor of Xu Province, died.

literal: On the guimao day, Liu Yibin, Governor of Southern Xu Province, was made Governor of Xu Province.
idiomatic: On the guimao day, Liu Yibin, Governor of Southern Xu Province, was appointed Governor of Xu Province.

literal: On the jiwei day of the ninth month, Shen Yanzhi, Director of the Central Army, was made General Who Leads the Army.
idiomatic: On the jiwei day of the ninth month, Shen Yanzhi, Director of the Central Army, was appointed General Who Leads the Army.

literal: On the xinwei day, Xu Zhanzhi, Supervisor of the Heir Apparent's Household, was made Governor of Southern Xu Province.
idiomatic: On the xinwei day, Xu Zhanzhi, Supervisor of the Heir Apparent's Household, was appointed Governor of Southern Xu Province.

literal: On the renwu day of the tenth month in winter, Hu Danshi of Yuzhang rebelled and killed Administrator Huan Longzhi; Tan Hezhi, former Governor of Jiao Province, was returning south and reached Yuzhang, whereupon he suppressed and pacified the rebellion.
idiomatic: On the renwu day of the tenth month in winter, Hu Danshi of Yuzhang rebelled and killed Administrator Huan Longzhi; Tan Hezhi, former Governor of Jiao Province, was returning south and reached Yuzhang, whereupon he suppressed the rebellion.

literal: On the renchen day, Hong, Prince of Jianping, was made General of the Central Army.
idiomatic: On the renchen day, Prince of Jianping Hong was appointed General of the Central Army.

literal: On the jiayin day of the eleventh month, the tenth imperial son Hun was established as Prince of Ruyin.
idiomatic: On the jiayin day of the eleventh month, the tenth imperial son Hun was created Prince of Ruyin.

literal: On the wuchen day of the first month in spring of the twenty-fifth year, an edict said: "Of late ice and snow have lasted many days; fuel and grain have grown costly, and poor and distressed households are many in their straits.
idiomatic: On the wuchen day of the first month in spring of the twenty-fifth year, an edict said: "Of late ice and snow have lasted many days; fuel and grain have grown costly, and poor and distressed households are many in their straits.

literal: The two counties of the capital and the garrisons may be inspected and supplied with firewood and grain."
idiomatic: The two counties of the capital and the garrisons should be inspected and supplied with firewood and grain."

literal: On the gengyin day of the second month, an edict said: "In security one does not forget peril—this all ages hold in common;
idiomatic: On the gengyin day of the second month, an edict said: "In security one does not forget peril—this all ages hold in common;

literal: to train the army and teach warfare is the constant statute of a state.
idiomatic: to train the army and teach warfare is the constant statute of a state.

literal: Therefore when instruction is received and shame is understood, then young and old alike know prohibition.
idiomatic: Therefore when instruction is received and shame is understood, then young and old alike know prohibition.

literal: Of late military affairs have indeed been cultivated, yet orders and proclamations have not been made clear.
idiomatic: Of late military affairs have indeed been cultivated, yet orders and proclamations have not been made clear.

literal: Now that the Xuanyong training ground has just been completed, on a set day the mass of troops may be drilled on a great scale.
idiomatic: Now that the Xuanyong training ground has just been completed, on a set day the mass of troops may be drilled on a great scale.

literal: This should be carried out by means of a hunting review, to practice arms and discuss affairs."
idiomatic: This should be carried out by means of a hunting review, to practice arms and discuss affairs."

literal: On the jiyou day of the intercalary month, a great hunt was held at the Xuanyong training ground.
idiomatic: On the jiyou day of the intercalary month, a great hunt was held at the Xuanyong training ground.

literal: On the gengchen day of the third month, the imperial carriage conducted a hunting review.
idiomatic: On the gengchen day of the third month, the Emperor conducted a hunting review.

literal: On the yisi day of the fourth month in summer, the new Changhe and Guangmo gates were built; the former Guangmo gate was renamed Chenming, and Kaiyang was renamed Jinyang.
idiomatic: On the yisi day of the fourth month in summer, the new Changhe and Guangmo gates were built; the former Guangmo gate was renamed Chenming, and Kaiyang was renamed Jinyang.

literal: On the yimao day, Jun, Prince of Wuling, General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Yong Province, was made General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Xu Province.
idiomatic: On the yimao day, Prince of Wuling Jun, General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Yong Province, was appointed General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Xu Province.

literal: On the guihai day, Xiao Sihua, General of the Right Guards, was made Governor of Yong Province.
idiomatic: On the guihai day, Xiao Sihua, General of the Right Guards, was appointed Governor of Yong Province.

literal: On the jimao day of the fifth month, the large coin valued at two was abolished.
idiomatic: On the jimao day of the fifth month, the large coin valued at two was abolished.

literal: On the gengxu day of the sixth month, Sima Yuanyu, Senior Clerk of the Prince of Lingling, died.
idiomatic: On the gengxu day of the sixth month, Sima Yuanyu, Senior Clerk of the Prince of Lingling, died.

literal: On the gengshen day, Jun, Prince of Wuling, General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Xu Province, was additionally made Governor of Yan Province.
idiomatic: On the gengshen day, Prince of Wuling Jun, General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Xu Province, was additionally appointed Governor of Yan Province.

literal: On the bingyin day, Yixuan, Prince of Nanqiao, General of Chariots and Cavalry and Governor of Jing Province, was advanced to Minister of Works.
idiomatic: On the bingyin day, Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan, General of Chariots and Cavalry and Governor of Jing Province, was promoted to Minister of Works.

literal: On the renwu day of the seventh month in autumn, Wang Jinghong, Left Grandee of Splendid Virtue, died.
idiomatic: On the renwu day of the seventh month in autumn, Wang Jinghong, Left Grandee of Splendid Virtue, died.

literal: On the jiyou day of the eighth month, Liu Xiuzhi, Consulting Colonel of the Pacification Army, was made Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.
idiomatic: On the jiyou day of the eighth month, Liu Xiuzhi, Consulting Colonel of the Pacification Army, was appointed Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.

literal: On the jiazi day, the eleventh imperial son Yu was established as Prince of Huaiyang.
idiomatic: On the jiazi day, the eleventh imperial son Yu was created Prince of Huaiyang.

literal: On the xinwei day of the ninth month, He Shangzhi, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; Shen Yanzhi, General Who Leads the Army, was transferred from his post; Liu Zunkao, Administrator of Wuxing, was made General Who Leads the Army.
idiomatic: On the xinwei day of the ninth month, He Shangzhi, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, was appointed Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; Shen Yanzhi, General Who Leads the Army, was transferred from his post; Liu Zunkao, Administrator of Wuxing, was appointed General Who Leads the Army.

literal: On the xinsi day of the first month in spring of the twenty-sixth year, the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the southern suburb.
idiomatic: On the xinsi day of the first month in spring of the twenty-sixth year, the Emperor personally sacrificed at the southern suburb.

literal: On the jihai day of the second month, the imperial carriage traveled by land to Dantu and visited the Jing Mausoleum.
idiomatic: On the jihai day of the second month, the Emperor traveled by land to Dantu and visited the Jing Mausoleum.

literal: On the dingsi day of the third month, [34] an edict said: "I have been away from the northern capital for more than twenty years; though it is said to lie close at hand, I have had no road by which to gaze upon the journey thither.
idiomatic: On the dingsi day of the third month, [34] an edict said: "For more than twenty years I have been kept from the northern capital; though men say it lies near at hand, I have had no road by which to look upon the journey home.
